payload.subject: Document read vs ingest arbitration: default prioritizes paginated reader and triggers ingest only when there is clear value beyond the current answer
payload.recommendedAction: Use the paginated reader first for immediate answerability; trigger ingest only when there is clear value beyond the current answer.
payload.avoidAction: Do not make ingest the first user decision; keep immediate one-shot reading fast and low-side-effect.

payload.subject: Document read vs ingest arbitration: auto-schedule ingest only for capped output, continued reads with offset>1, or repeated reads of same file in same live tool set
payload.recommendedAction: Auto-schedule ingest only when there is a capped read output, the caller is continuing with offset > 1, or the same workspace-relative file is read again in the same live tool set.
payload.avoidAction: Keep outcome as read_only when none of those conditions are true.

payload.subject: Document read vs ingest arbitration: trigger ingest automatically under durable reuse/workload signals or explicit user reuse request
payload.recommendedAction: Trigger ingest automatically when one or more are true: document size makes repeated paginated reads wasteful; user asks for follow-up work implying durable reuse; document likely becomes a recurring project source; system detects multiple queries against the same document in one session; user explicitly asks to remember, package, or reuse the document later.

payload.subject: Document dedupe model: identify documents with stable URI/path, content hash, and ingest profile/privacy scope; derive deterministic run id and durable record path
payload.recommendedAction: Use one document identity record keyed by normalized source URI or file path when stable, content hash for fetched bytes, and ingest profile or privacy scope when that changes retention semantics.
payload.avoidAction: Do not vary identity semantics without including changes to retention semantics (ingest profile/privacy scope).
payload.neededCapability: Deterministic fingerprinting and mapping to run id and durable record path.

payload.subject: Document dedupe model: reuse existing current ingest record for chunk lookup and grounding; avoid re-ingest unless content hash changed
payload.recommendedAction: If the reader touches a document that already has a current ingest record, reuse that record for chunk lookup and answer grounding.
payload.avoidAction: Do not re-ingest unless the content hash changed.

payload.subject: Document dedupe model: reuse already fetched bytes/pagination metadata for ingest that starts after a read
payload.recommendedAction: If ingest starts after a read, reuse the already fetched bytes and pagination metadata.
payload.avoidAction: Do not fetch the document a second time unless the source changed.

payload.subject: Document read vs ingest arbitration current scope boundaries
payload.recommendedAction: Apply the arbitration logic only to host-side reads, files inside the active workspace root, likely text documents only, and the live model_memory_document_ingest tool when that tool is present and allowed.
payload.avoidAction: Do not auto-ingest images, PDFs or binary files; do not auto-ingest files outside the workspace root; do not attempt auto-ingest when the model-memory ingest tool is not active.

payload.subject: Telemetry/traceability: read tool writes details.documentArbitration fields
payload.value: The read tool writes `details.documentArbitration` with: outcome, workspaceRelativePath, fingerprint, triggers, ingestStatus, runId, recordPath, and projectId when derivable from docs/projects/<id>/...

payload.subject: User control: arbitration behavior can be overridden only via explicit override requests
payload.recommendedAction: Allow the user to override behavior only as an override request: read only; ingest for later; do not retain this.
payload.avoidAction: Do not allow overrides outside of explicit override requests.

Auto-schedule ingest only when the read output is capped, the caller is continuing with offset > 1, or the same workspace-relative file is read again within the same live tool set; otherwise keep outcome read_only.

When deciding whether to ingest, auto-ingest only for safe cases like large documents, follow-up durable reuse, recurring project need, multiple queries in one session, or explicit user request to remember/reuse later.

Do not auto-ingest when the document is obviously transient, only a quick read is requested, privacy policy/source classification says session-local retention, or a recent ingest fingerprint exists and no new chunks would be added.

Use one document identity keyed by stable normalized source URI/path plus content hash and ingest profile/privacy scope; the auto-ingest run id and durable record path are deterministic per fingerprint.
If a reader touches a document with an existing current ingest record, reuse it for chunk lookup/grounding and do not re-ingest unless the content hash changed.
If ingest starts after a read, reuse already fetched bytes and pagination metadata and do not fetch the document a second time unless the source changed.
